purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel sources for Elelim, Indonesia; claims are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Elelim

queries.query: Elelim Papua Indonesia official cadastral parcel map GIS ATR BPN
queries.result: Found the official ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS public geospatial portals, plus the official Yalimo government site. Search results describe BHUMI as an open interactive land/spatial map, but no Elelim-specific anonymous parcel response was established.

queries.query: Elelim Papua Indonesia peta kadaster pertanahan resmi GIS ATR BPN
queries.result: Found the official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS portals and documentation describing bidang tanah/persil layers, and a Yalimo land-service result outside the official ATR/BPN domain. No safe public Elelim parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

officialSources.observation: Current official ATR/BPN BHUMI entry point was reachable. Its HTML loads the current konsolbhumi.atrbpn.go.id viewer iframe; the public landing material describes an interactive land/spatial map and cautions that official use requires the public-information process. No anonymous Elelim feature response was obtained.

Current official ATR/BPN ATLAS portal was reachable. Its visible catalog exposed seven public sources, including land-office locations, but no Elelim parcel layer or safe bounded parcel response was identified.

Official Yalimo Regency government site identifies Elelim as the regency administrative context and gives an Elelim government address. This is local-government context, not parcel geometry or proof of cadastral coverage.

Official BHUMI help page documents map elements including land parcels/bidang tanah and coordinate display. It does not expose a city-specific public schema, CRS response, or downloadable Elelim geometry in the observed page.

requests.outcome: Anonymous page loaded. Current catalog was inspected; no Elelim parcel service or parcel schema/CRS was exposed in the observed catalog.

registryBasis: The official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS public land-map portals evidence Indonesia's national cadastral/spatial custodian and public map entry point. Elelim-specific local coverage or a local parcel service was not established.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ATR/BPN operates official national land/spatial portals that document parcel/bidang tanah mapping.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Only official portal and documentation availability was verified; no Elelim parcel geometry, native ID, schema, or CRS was returned anonymously.

remainingUncertainty: BHUMI may expose Elelim parcel data through an interactive route or a service requiring additional public workflow. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. A zero exact-point hit, forbidden route, timeout, or incomplete viewer inspection is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
